items.title: Investor Reaction to Fed Decision Could Depend on Dissents
items.summary: Interest-rate futures show that traders see a 29.4% chance that the Fed raises rates versus a 70.6% chance that it stays on hold, according to CME Group data.  Cleveland Fed President Beth Hammack and Dallas Fed President Lorie Logan are expected by many to vote in favor of raising rates.  Investors will also pay close attention to Fed Chairman Kevin Warsh’s post-meeting press conference, although the new Fed leader has been at pains to say little about the direction of rates.

items.title: CME Group (CME) Stock Gets Fair Value Trim As Analysts Debate Earnings Strength
items.summary: CME Group’s fair value estimate has been trimmed from US$289.00 to about US$282.36, a reduction of roughly 2.3% that reflects updated model assumptions. This more measured price target sits alongside a split analyst narrative, with some research pointing to strong earnings and product moats, while others highlight competitive threats and softer volume assumptions. As you read on, you will see how these moving parts are shaping the evolving story around CME Group and what to watch...

items.title: FIA CEO on Prediction Market 'Disruption,' Regulation
items.summary: As prediction market giants like Kalshi and Polymarket begin offering perpetual futures trading with CFTC approval, other investment platforms are looking to expand their offerings. CME Group is launching single-stock futures, allowing investors to hedge or speculate on more than 50 of the largest US companies. The contracts, offering leverage without the complexity of options, will be cash-settled on the closing price of the stocks they're tied to. FIA CEO Walt Lukken joins Bloomberg Businessweek Daily to discuss the launch of these investment products, why he says prediction market "disruption" is good for building out best regulatory practices for the industry, and more. Lukken speaks with Carol Massar and Tim Stenovec.

items.title: Market Reaction to Fed Could Depend on Dissents
items.summary: Investors are fairly confident that the Federal Reserve will keep interest rates unchanged on Wednesday.  Interest-rate futures showed late Tuesday that traders see a 31.5% chance that the Fed raises rates versus a 68.5% chance that it stays on hold, according to CME Group data.  Cleveland Fed President Beth Hammack and Dallas Fed President Lorie Logan are widely expected to vote in favor of raising rates.

items.title: How CME’s New 24/7 Gold and Single-Stock Futures Push Will Impact CME Group (CME) Investors
items.summary: CME Group reported its second-quarter 2026 results in the past week, with revenue of US$1,706.2 million and net income of US$1,041.8 million, alongside updated share repurchase activity under its 2024 buyback program.
